headlines.name: Nvidia
headlines.headline: Nvidia posts a blockbuster quarter as Jensen Huang’s dealmaking legacy hangs in the balance
headlines.description: Morgan Chittum here. Nvidia posted quarterly results late Tuesday that handily beat earnings and revenue expectations—just days after Jensen Huang resigned as CEO following reports of extramarital affairs. The upheaval sent the stock to its lowest level in well over a year. The better-than-expected fiscal third quarter may give public-market investors a reprieve.

headlines.description: When Chris Van Hollen first ran for Senate in 2016, he was considered the pro-Israel, Democratic establishment pick with the backing of AIPAC-aligned donors .
